noisy-neighbour isolation: cpu-cap — no rdt_a flag, so cache and DRAM bandwidth stay shared; give a bandwidth-heavy neighbour a CPU limit. the CPU has VT-x (vmx) but /dev/kvm is missing: no microVM sandboxes
findings.why: kvm_intel creates /dev/kvm; without it Kata or Firecracker cannot start a VM

findings.apply: BIOS: enable VT-d, then add intel_iommu=on to the kernel command line and reboot
findings.revert: remove intel_iommu=on from the kernel command line and reboot
findings.text: no IOMMU unit registered: no DMA isolation between devices, no GPU passthrough into a microVM
findings.why: VFIO hands a device to a VM only with its IOMMU group; without VT-d enabled there are no groups

sections.good: cores ramp to full turbo the moment a request arrives: EPP performance or balance_performance, turbo on, no frequency caps — token generation is a latency-bound loop and every ramp-up shows in time-to-first-token
sections.name: CPU frequency (driver none)

sections.good: /dev/kvm usable for microVM sandboxes, each GPU alone in its IOMMU group, split-lock detection on, CET known, GPU observation streams limited to CAP_PERFMON
